name: igem_database

management.reason: The parent repository already treats external_repos as ignored, read-only nested Git references. A tracked lock plus detached sparse checkout preserves that contract without mixing upstream history or generated dependencies into the parent repository.

upstream_hygiene_observations: frontend/node_modules is tracked upstream and is deliberately excluded from the sparse worktree
frontend/dist and IDE metadata are tracked upstream and are treated as reference-only artifacts
backend/.env is tracked upstream; its contents must never be copied, logged, committed, or used as a parent-repository configuration source
